name: Emily Alatalo
bio: Emily Alatalo is a Canadian actress born in Sudbury, Ontario. She is best known for her role as Ginnie McMillan on "Workin' Moms" (Netflix/CBC) and as Cara Martin in "Christmas Plus One" (Lifetime). Emily was born into a family of athletes and outdoor enthusiasts.
